visible.title: STREAMLIT_SERVER_BASE_URL_PATH not working with `docker run -e STREAMLIT_SERVER_BASE_URL_PATH=test_path`
visible.body:
### Checklist

### Summary

I'm trying to run a Streamlit application docker container with the `STREAMLIT_SERVER_BASE_URL_PATH` environment variable according to the [documentation here](https://docs.streamlit.io/develop/concepts/configuration/options). The same configuration worked if I include the configuration in the `.streamlit/.config.toml` when building the image, but not working when trying to run the container with the environment variable.

Relevant discussion:
https://discuss.streamlit.io/t/run-streamlit-app-on-specific-url-path/32147

### Reproducible Code Example

```Python
docker run --rm --env STREAMLIT_SERVER_BASE_URL_PATH=test -p 8501:8501 <image_id>
```

### Steps To Reproduce

To reproduce the issue:
1. Create a streamlit application with a docker image
2. Run the docker image with the `-e STREAMLIT_SERVER_BASE_URL_PATH=test_path` argument
3. You will see that the application is running on `Local URL: http://localhost:8501` instead of `Local URL: http://localhost/test_path:8501`

### Expected Behavior

The `-e STREAMLIT_SERVER_BASE_URL_PATH=test_path` should work and the applicaiton should run on `localhost/test_path`

### Current Behavior

Only runs on `localhost`

### Is this a regression?

- [ ] Yes, this used to work in a previous version.

### Debug info

- Streamlit version: 1.45.1
- Python version: 3.13.2
- Operating System: Mac OS 15.5 (24F74)
- Browser: Chrome Version 137.0.7151.41 (Official Build) (arm64)

### Additional Information

gold.summary: STREAMLIT_SERVER_BASE_URL_PATH env var ignored with docker run -e (config.toml works).
hypotheses: app started via a custom launcher (bootstrap.run) that bypasses env/CLI config
env var not set in container / wrong name

missing_info.item: is the env var visible inside the container

acceptable_next_steps: Ask Dockerfile ENTRYPOINT/CMD and inspect the env variable plus effective server.baseUrlPath.
Test the actual /test path with a standard streamlit run launcher as a controlled comparison.
must_not: State bootstrap.run caused it before the June 30 user reply.
gold.reference: Maintainer couldn't reproduce; user later: code used bootstrap.run(), needs flag_options.
gold.review_reason: The supplied env variable is valid. The launch command/entrypoint and effective config are missing; bootstrap.run is revealed only later. A printed root URL alone is not a decisive routing test.

acceptable_next_steps: Ask for Dockerfile/launch command; confirm env var naming per config docs
must_not: confirm a bug before ruling out the launcher
